title: PaymentFailedPayload
description: Payload of the payment.failed event (routing key payment.failed), wrapped in envelope.v1.json. Published by Payment when the simulated provider declined an order's payment; consumed by Ordering (saga: cancels the order) and Inventory (compensation: releases the reservation).

reason.description: Human-readable cause, e.g. provider_declined. Informational only: consumers must not branch on it.
